title: Dutch Parliamentary Election Study 1971-1979 (DPES/NKO 1971-1979), panel data
contributors: Universiteit van Amsterdam, Subfac. Politieke en Sociale Wetenschappen (depositor)
Werkgroep nationaal kiezersonderzoekVertegenwoordigers Nederlandse universiteiten * Amsterdam, Nijmegen, LeidenSubfac. politieke en sociale wetenschappen, FSW-A, UvA * Amsterdam (research initiator)
NSS - nv. v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den HaagInteract bv * Dongen (data collector)
descriptions: Assessing electoral change in the Netherlands. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership. The data- and documentation files of this dataset can be downloaded via the option Data Files.
